name: Octopus Prime
tagline: An AI employee that works your computer 24/7
description: Octopus Prime is an AI agent platform where each agent works like an employee at a desk. Agents run 24/7 on a computer you own, work in your real apps with their own browser and your own logins (kept in a vault they can use but never read), and wait for a one-tap OK before sending, publishing or paying. People and AI agents share chats, tasks, a calendar and files in one workspace. You can watch any agent live, take over at any time, or stop one with a single button that saves its work first. Apps for Mac, Windows, Linux, iPhone and Android.
